propositions: Bridge cannot support multiple tracker projects against one codebase; JiraConfig.project, fetcher JQL builder, and applier cross-project guard are each hardwired to a single project key.

Multi-project support requires a shared store-level project mapping (.bridge_state/projects.json) and per-ticket project/repos fields to track project sync scope and repo membership without corrupting prev_snapshot.json diffs.

Ticket project field is tri-state (absent=legacy default, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit key=sync there) and migration must resolve all pre-feature tickets to the store's recorded legacy default with zero event writes.

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate all configured projects, issue one JQL pair per project, run enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink) once per project, and merge results into a single snapshot keyed by issue.
Outbound dispatch relaxes cross-project guard from single-project match to set membership; tickets with explicit-empty project produce no mutations.
Multi-project stores must carry 'multi-project-bridge' in required_capabilities; binaries lacking it refuse writes; single-project stores remain writable by older binaries.
